profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at NextGen Federal Systems

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• design, development, support and maintenance of the Air Force CIDNE systems.
• design and development of SATA software for USMC (built on NodeJs/Postgres)
• data model creation for customizable reporting system to be used in CIDNE 4x
• integration of index services like Solr and ElasticSearch
• assisted with architecture and design of dataflow between multiple reporting systems
• implementation and testing of generic form authoring capability
• design and implementation of generic reporting replication solution transforming data between differing data structures/stores
• design and implementation of common service layers for CIDNE on multiple platforms including DAE, Webtas Enterprise and Windows Server.
• led web and custom data interface efforts for CIDNE on DAE along with serving as the lead for various replication efforts
• creation and modification of THRIFT services to be used on DAE Platform

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
design, development, support and maintenance of the Coast Guard, Army and DISA systems.
• assisted with RRA porting GCCS-J products to Data virtualization layer (GemFire caches)
• worked to develop and enforce secure coding plan and processes for GCCS
• lead design/implementation of system of system architecture for CRAM (disconnected mobile applications, web interface, and RESTful web services with SQL Server backend)
• acted as lead for the implementation and delivery of data collection and analysis utilities (WILDCAT)
• gathered requirements and contribute to the design/implementation of the CSRDB for CRAM
• developed a WCF service and Silverlight protoype for Search and Rescue Alerts for USCG
• maintain and improve COMDAC navigation software as well as SAROPS program
• administered/maintained Windows and Solaris nightly builds as well as created numerous automated tests for the various baselines

positions.title: Teaching/Research Assistant
positions.description: development and implementation of evaluation framework, statistical data analysis, research on current medical imaging applications, development of robust similarity metrics for image registration

positions.title: I.T. Specialist/Consultant
positions.description: computer programming, network administration, hire/manage IT Staff
